verdict.rationale: Stripe documents that API keys determine which resources an integration can access (stripe-docs-58) and that agents can get their own sandbox with working API keys isolated from live data (stripe-docs-16, stripe-docs-49), suggesting some least-privilege mechanism for agent credentials. However, there is no explicit documentation of a granular permission/scoping UI or API for restricted keys tailored to agent use, nor any hands-on confirmation of scoped-credential issuance for an AI agent specifically. Missing for 10: explicit docs on restricted/scoped API key creation with permission granularity, agent-specific credential scoping guidance, and independent verification of least-privilege enforcement in practice.
